grading_basis: Unchanged original answer-key.json; all requested parts compared semantically by parent evaluator. No credit for an omitted material fact.

grades.expected_answer: Shuffle 12 Speed, 3 Starting Upgrade and 3 Stress cards (18 total) into the draw deck. Put 6 Heat face up in the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
grades.observed_answer: Shuffle 12 Speed, 3 Starting Upgrade, and 3 Stress cards into the initial draw deck. Place 6 Heat face up on the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.

grades.expected_answer: Staying in the same gear is allowed. A two-position shift such as 1st to 3rd costs 1 Heat, paid immediately during Shift Gears by moving a Heat card from Engine to discard.
grades.observed_answer: Yes, you may stay. You may shift from 1st to 3rd by immediately paying 1 Heat during Shift Gears, from Engine to discard. You must have the Engine Heat available.
grades.summary_evidence: Shift Gears: "Stay in your current gear"; "shift two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat during this step: move a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile."
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: No. Commit exactly 3 playable cards face down in the Play Area.
grades.observed_answer: No. You must commit 3 cards face down in 3rd gear.
grades.summary_evidence: Play Cards: "Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number ... 3rd = 3".
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous across players, in that order. After everyone finishes them, take steps 3–9 one player at a time, each completing their turn before the next, from front to back. The car closest to the Race Line acts first when side by side.
grades.observed_answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous across players, with step 1 before step 2. Step 3 waits until everyone finishes both. Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next starts step 3. Frontmost acts first; side by side, the car closest to the Race Line acts first.
grades.summary_evidence: Turn Structure and Sequential Phase: "All players complete steps 1 and 2 simultaneously, in that order"; "Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next player begins step 3"; "the car closest to the Race Line is ahead for all purposes".
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: Cars do not block passage. If the destination is full, stop in the first space with a free spot behind the blocking cars, preferring the spot closest to the Race Line.
grades.observed_answer: Cars never block passage. With the destination full, use the first free spot behind the blocking cars, preferring the spot closest to the Race Line if available.
grades.summary_evidence: Blocked Movement: "Cars never block passage ... first free spot behind the blocking cars." Reveal & Move: "Place your car on the spot closest to the Race Line if available."
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: Discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade. Put Speed 3 in the Play Area on the played Stress; the Stress remains in that area until normal cleanup. It contributes speed 3. Resolve all Stress before Adrenaline.
grades.observed_answer: Immediately discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade. Put Speed 3 in the Play Area on top of the played Stress, which remains underneath. The Stress supplies speed 3. Discard both during Replenish Hand. Resolve this before Adrenaline.
grades.summary_evidence: Stress Cards: "Immediately discard each flipped non-Speed card, including Heat, Stress and Starting Upgrade cards"; "Put the found Speed card in your Play Area on top of the played Stress card"; "Discard both during Replenish Hand"; "Resolve all played Stress cards before moving on to Adrenaline."
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. Each gains access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 speed during React, before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be carried over.
grades.observed_answer: The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. Each gains access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed during React. The extra speed can be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.
grades.summary_evidence: Adrenaline: "If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits"; "1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed"; "before or after Boost"; "Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved for another round."
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: Yes. React symbols may be activated in any order. 2nd gear gives Cooldown 1, so first move the Heat from hand to Engine, then pay that Heat from Engine to discard for one Boost.
grades.observed_answer: Yes. 2nd gear provides Cooldown 1, so return that Heat from hand to Engine, then immediately spend it from Engine to discard to Boost. React allows these actions in either order.
grades.summary_evidence: Cooldown: "2nd gear (Cooldown 1)". React: "Activate available Cooldown and/or Boost symbols in any order. You may Cooldown Heat from your hand into your Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost."
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: At most once per turn, costing 1 Heat from Engine to discard. An empty Engine prevents Boost unless Heat is first returned via available Cooldown. Flip and discard non-Speed cards until a Speed card appears; add that card to played cards and move its value. Boost speed counts for corners.

Flip until a Speed card appears, discarding each non-Speed immediately. Put the Speed card in the Play Area and move its value; its speed counts for corners.

grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer; no unresolved part or contradictory ruling.

grades.expected_answer: The corner requires 3 Heat but only 2 are available, so pay both Engine Heat into discard and spin out. Move to the first available space before that corner, take 2 Stress directly into hand, and set gear to 1st.
